description: Carob is an R extract-transform-load framework that standardises primary agricultural research datasets. Its README says each contributing experiment or survey has a conversion script that maps names, units and accepted values into a shared form, so collections can be used for predictive analysis. Users select source studies and run the appropriate scripts; outputs are harmonised tables for crop or management models. Geographic coverage follows the studies contributed. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the framework; individual research datasets need their own terms and attribution. A limitation is that harmonised columns do not erase differences in experimental design, climate or management practice. The package can help prepare yield or irrigation response inputs for agriculture and food-supply simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform handles spatial processing, not this agronomic ETL workflow. No study dataset or R package was downloaded.
name: Carob agricultural research data ETL
